newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS CONFIRMS ONTARIO, ONTARIO HYDRO.
newsitem.headline: DBRS CONFIRMS ONTARIO, ONTARIO HYDRO.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Wednesday it confirmed the ratings of the Province of Ontario's long-term debt at A (high) and short-term debt at R-1 (middle), with stable trends.
The ratings of Ontario Hydro were also confirmed as the province guarantees Ontario Hydro's debt.
The confirmation followed an initial review of provincial government-owned Ontario Hydro's announcement today of a major overhaul of its nuclear facilities.
The upgrade was expected to add between C$5 billion and C$8 billion to Ontario Hydro's costs between 1997 and 2001.
That additional cost reduced Ontario Hydro's ability to lower its debt load significantly by the year 2000, as previously planned, DBRS said.
The upgrade costs also reduced Ontario Hydro's ability to deal with the future challenge of potential competition due to deregulation, the ratings agency said.
DBRS said it would closely follow developments, especially the issuing of the province's white paper on Ontario Hydro's future direction, and would make a follow-up assessment at that time.
